gizmo.title: Kaadị akụkọ Polaris
gizmo.description: Gosi kaadị akụkọ Polaris nwere onyonyo azụ, akara aha ogidi, na ederede isiokwu.

configure.title: Onyonyo azụ
configure.description: URL onyonyo a na-egosi dịka azụ kaadị.

configure.title: Nha azụ
configure.description: Otu onyonyo azụ si jupụta kaadị ahụ (CSS background-size).

configure.title: Njikọ azụ
configure.description: Otu onyonyo azụ si akpa àgwà mgbe a na-akpụgharị (CSS background-attachment).

configure.title: Akara aha ogidi
configure.description: Akara aha mkpụmkpụ na mkpụrụedemede ukwu a na-egosi n'elu kaadị. Hapụ ya efu iji zoo ya.

configure.title: Ederede kaadị
configure.description: Ederede bụ isi a na-egosi na mpaghara ala.

configure.title: Njikọ
configure.description: URL ebe a na-aga nhọrọ nke na-ekpuchi kaadị ahụ niile.
